$comment: Single source of truth for fleet secrets. KV is authoritative; local files are derived. Run scripts/secrets/sync.py to populate, scripts/secrets/status.py to check freshness. Edit this file when adding a new secret OR when rotating ownership; rotation of a VALUE only happens in KV (then run sync). See docs/secrets-management.md.

secrets.description: Azure Foundry Cohere embed-v4 API key (1536-d) used by backend-core for vector embeddings.
Tavily web-search API key used by backend-core llm-gateway /v1/tools/search (ARC-ADR-021). Set LLM_GATEWAY_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED=true to activate the surface.
Cerebras inference API key used by middle-core agent_runtime LLM factory (ARC-ADR-004).
OpenAI API key — backup provider routed via llm-gateway LiteLLM dispatcher.
Postman PMAK for the AgentArmy workspace (64b63429-...). Used by contract/mock publishing tooling.
Claude GitHub App OAuth token used by .github/workflows/claude.yml for @claude PR/issue mentions and the review-loop label.
ArcadeDB root password — used by the local-stack arcadedb container (templates/local-stack/docker-compose.yml).
ArcadeDB service-user password — used by the local-stack arcadedb container AND backend-core (must match so backend can authenticate).

secrets.$note: Backend-core's .env uses ARCADEDB_USER=root, so its secrets file holds the ROOT password. local-stack's platform_reader user is for read-only consumers; backend-core does schema setup on startup and needs root.
secrets.description: Backend-core's .secrets/arcadedb_password.txt — read by ARCADEDB_PASSWORD_FILE when set; holds the ArcadeDB root credential matching local-stack's arcadedb-root-password.
